theater: 波洛茨克至奧爾沙戰線

battle.name: 第三次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭
battle.theater: 波洛茨克至奧爾沙戰線
battle.brief: 一五〇七年伊凡三世乘利沃尼亞騎士團內訌西征，莫斯科大軍在波洛茨克、維捷布斯克與奧爾沙一線受阻；一五〇八年舒伊斯基兩度圍城，重砲未能破壞石造堡壘，十月八日雙方訂下永久和平。蒙斯梅格這門鑄鐵攻城臼炮代表當時火炮的技術頂點，卻從未到過東線。

kit.name: 蒙斯梅格攻城臼炮
kit.history: 蒙斯梅格屬於英格蘭王國的重型攻城臼炮，歸入王室攻城砲兵，部署於圍城陣地，主要任務是攻擊城牆及堡壘。

countries: 一五〇七年至〇八年的戰事，主角是莫斯科大公國與立陶宛大公國。莫斯科方面，國主伊凡三世自任統帥，率領由諸王公分領的大軍：中央為大公本陣與前鋒、後衛，斯特列爾齊（射手）以火繩步槍承擔全軍主要火力，專管火器的普什卡爾斯克御前衙門同時負責鑄砲、炮手編制與重砲調配，分封王公如舒伊斯基、維亞澤姆斯基、羅斯托夫斯基、多爾戈魯科夫各自領兵隨行。立陶宛方面，統治者是大公亞歷山大·雅格隆，以大公會議決定對俄用兵，軍隊由立陶宛與魯塞尼亞封建主的騎兵「羅塔」、羅斯系親兵隊、受大公節制的克里米亞韃靼兵，以及波蘭王室的撥款與援軍拼成，邊境要塞的守備與後勤糧秣亦歸同一套機構管理。利沃尼亞騎士團因自身派系內鬥，一度在莫斯科一邊；克里米亞汗國則站在立陶宛一邊。兩邊指揮體系一邊是君主的絕對號令，一邊是會議與世襲領袖的折衷，這在決策速度上直接影響戰局。
countriesEn: The war of 1507–1508 was fought between the Grand Duchy of Moscow and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. On the Muscovite side Grand Prince Ivan III commanded in person, and the host was organised around the sovereign's own household, the vanguard and the rearguard, with the appanage princes contributing their retainers: the Streltsy, the shooters, provided the mass of the musket fire, while the Pouchkar Prikaz, the Muscovite office of firearms, was responsible for the foundries, the crews and the issue of heavy siege guns; princes such as Shuisky, Vyazemsky, Rostovsky and Dolgorukov served with their own detachments. On the Lithuanian side the ruler was Grand Duke Alexander Jagiellon, who governed the war together with the Grand Ducal Council; the host was composed of the roty of Lithuanian and Ruthenian heavy cavalry, the Ruthenian druzhinas bound by personal service to the duke, the Crimean Tatar contingents placed under his command, and the money and auxiliaries supplied by the Polish Crown; the border fortresses, their garrisons and the whole provisioning system belonged to the same administration. The Livonian Order, rent by its own factional quarrel, appeared for a time on the Muscovite side, while the Crimean Horde, hostile to Moscow, supported the Grand Duke. The two systems of command were thus fundamentally different: on one side the absolute command of a single sovereign, on the other a compromise between a council and hereditary leaders, and that difference showed directly in how fast decisions were taken.
people: 伊凡三世是這場戰爭的發動者，也是最終沒有拿到想要土地的一方。他在一五〇七年調集大軍向西推進，企圖利用利沃尼亞騎士團內部的權鬥（團長與多爾帕特主教的衝突）打開缺口，並一舉吞下斯摩稜斯克、波洛茨克、維捷布斯克等魯塞尼亞城地。一五〇八年，他派王室出身的瓦西里·舒伊斯基接掌指揮：這位大公之弟兩度率軍圍城，先攻維捷布斯克、後攻奧爾沙，兩個方向皆無功而還。立陶宛方面的關鍵人物是大公亞歷山大本人與大元帥（hetman）一系的統兵者，編年常把孔斯坦丁·奧斯特羅格斯基及其兄弟伊拉季翁列在前線主導者之中；莫斯科的安德烈·波霍夫等鑄炮師傅代表另一條戰線，他在一四九四年鑄出第一門俄羅斯砲，使火器衙門第一次以制度化方式供應重砲。最受爭議的人物是米哈伊爾·格林斯基：據傳他在戰事末段離開莫斯科投向立陶宛，率領哥薩克與越境騎兵擾亂莫斯科邊區，令伊凡三世震怒，也加深了雙方互不信任。各家編年對上述人物的行止與日期多不一致，諸說並存。
peopleEn: Ivan III was the man who started this war and the man who did not get the territories he wanted. In 1507 he concentrated a large army to the west, hoping to exploit the internal quarrel inside the Livonian Order, between its master and the bishop of Dorpat, and at one stroke to seize Smolensk, Polotsk and Vitebsk, the Ruthenian towns and lands. In 1508 he handed the command to Vasily Shuisky, a prince of the royal house: this brother of the grand prince besieged twice, first Vitebsk and then Orsha, and both sieges ended without result. On the Lithuanian side the key figures were the grand duke himself and the commanders of the hetmanate, with Konstanty Ostrogski and his brother Iladion named in the chronicles among those who led the fighting in the field; on the Muscovite side the gun-founders, and above all Andrei Chokhov, represented a different line of force, since under him the firearms office supplied heavy guns as an institution for the first time, his first Russian cannon dating from 1494. The most disputed person is Mikhail Glinsky: according to the tradition he left Muscovy for Lithuania in the last years of the war and led Cossacks and mounted raiders across the border into the Muscovite districts, which roused Ivan III's fury and deepened the mistrust on both sides. The chronicles disagree about the conduct and the dates of these men, and the competing versions have to be treated with caution.
kits: 卡面這件蒙斯梅格攻城臼炮，是英格蘭王國的重型攻城臼炮：一四四九年在勃艮第的蒙斯（今日比利時境內）鑄成，鑄鐵炮身重逾四噸半，內徑約一公尺，裝藥約二百公斤，發射直徑約一公尺、重約半噸的巨石彈，射程僅數百公尺，須靠牛隊牽引移位，操作要十餘人。牠代表十五世紀末歐洲攻城火炮的技術頂點，但必須說明：蒙斯梅格從未到過莫斯科前線，牠一直留在英格蘭王室攻城砲兵的序列裡，一四八〇年前後隨愛德華四世遠征蘇格蘭時還參與過愛丁堡與斯特靈一帶的圍城。在東線，與蒙斯梅格屬同一技術世代的是俄羅斯自己的鑄鐵重砲：安德烈·波霍夫一四九四年鑄成第一門俄羅斯野砲，一五〇二至〇三年又鑄成更重的一門，其鐵彈至今藏於莫斯科克里姆林宮武器館；立陶宛方面同樣保有自己的大砲與手鎗，雙方攻城都靠這些重砲壓制城頭。火器之外，步兵以火繩步槍（俄語 пищаль）與早期手槍為主，騎兵仍以長槍衝鋒，另有壕溝、木柵、雲梯與坑道掘進配合攻城。蒙斯梅格之重，正說明攻城砲兵在這場戰爭裡的角色：砲兵決定了圍城能持續多久，卻沒有決定誰能拿下城牆。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, Mons Meg, is a heavy siege bombard of the English Crown: cast in 1449 at Mons in Burgundy, in present-day Belgium, its iron barrel weighs more than four and a half tonnes, its bore is about one metre across, the charge is roughly two hundred kilograms of gunpowder, and it fires a stone ball about one metre in diameter and half a tonne in weight, with a range of only a few hundred metres; it had to be hauled on teams of oxen and worked by a dozen or more men. It represents the technical summit of fifteenth-century European siege artillery, but it must be said plainly that Mons Meg never reached the eastern front: it stayed in the English royal siege train, and around 1480 it went with Edward IV to Scotland, taking part in the sieges around Edinburgh and Stirling. On the eastern front the technical counterparts of Mons Meg were the Muscovite cast-iron heavy guns: Andrei Chokhov cast the first Russian cannon in 1494 and a heavier one between 1502 and 1503, whose iron ball is still kept in the Kremlin Armoury; the Grand Duchy of Lithuania had its own great guns and hand culverins, and both sides built their siegecraft on such pieces. Beyond the artillery the infantry relied on matchlock muskets (пищаль) and early handguns, the cavalry still charged with the lance, and the siege train added ditches, wooden galleries, scaling ladders and sapping to the effect of the guns. The sheer weight of Mons Meg is precisely the point: the siege artillery decided how long a siege could last, but it did not decide who would take the wall.
tactics: 莫斯科方面的打法是典型的十五世紀末大陸式大軍進攻：先以輕重騎兵掃清邊境，再由牛車隊把攻城砲車、攻城塔與糧秣緩緩運過德維納河與第聶伯河的分水嶺，大軍分兩路，一路指向波洛茨克與維捷布斯克，一路壓向利沃尼亞方向；抵達後立即築圍城寨、挖壕設柵，把重砲架在居高臨下的斜坡上，同時以坑道與射擊孔逼近城牆，步兵以火繩步槍、弓弩掩護工兵，騎兵在營地外警戒並追擊敵方襲擾。立陶宛方面的戰術核心是不決戰、只消耗：大公主力避免在不開闊之地與俄軍正面交鋒，集中重騎兵打擊分兵與糧道，藉克里米亞與羅斯系騎兵擴大縱深破壞，逼俄軍在冬季與疫病中曠日持久，坐等其攻城砲力竭。一五〇八年舒伊斯基兩度圍城時，立陶宛守軍採取閉門不出、以輕騎游擊補給線、最後以援軍在城下迫其解圍的做法。兩邊都大量使用冷兵器與火器混編的密集隊形，這正是重砲與重騎威力互相抵消的年代。
tacticsEn: The Muscovite method was the classic late-fifteenth-century continental army offensive: light and heavy cavalry first swept the border, then ox-drawn teams moved the gun carriages, the siege towers and the provisions slowly across the watershed between the Dvina and the Dnieper, and the host marched in two columns, one towards Polotsk and Vitebsk and one towards Livonia. On arrival the besiegers at once dug in, ringed the camp with trenches and stockades, planted the heavy guns on the slopes that overlooked the castle, drove saps and firing shafts up to the walls, and covered the sappers with matchlock muskets, crossbows and bows, while cavalry screened the camps and chased off raiding parties. The core of the Lithuanian tactic was to refuse the pitched battle and simply wear the enemy down: the grand duke's main host avoided meeting the Muscovites in the open wherever the ground was unfavourable, concentrated the heavy cavalry against detached columns and against the supply lines, and used the Crimean and Ruthenian horse to strike deep, hoping to exhaust the Muscovite besiegers through the winter and through disease. During Shuisky's two sieges of 1508 the Lithuanian garrisons stayed behind their walls, sent light cavalry to harry the supply columns, and finally brought up a relief force that forced the besiegers to raise the siege. Both armies fought in dense formations that mixed cold weapons with firearms, and it was precisely in such an age that the effect of heavy guns and of heavy cavalry cancelled each other out.
data: 可核對的數字有限，只能列出比較可靠的部分。兵器方面：蒙斯梅格全重約四點五噸，炮膛內徑約一〇一〇毫米，藥室裝黑火藥約二百公斤，石彈重約五百公斤，標稱射程數百公尺，圍城時每日耗藥量可觀，砲車須以數十頭牛馬拖曳。軍力方面，編年稱伊凡三世大軍「十萬」或「數萬」，實際集結的莫斯科軍按當時常規當在數萬人上下，立陶宛、波蘭與韃靼聯軍同樣以數萬計，多數史料的具體人數互相矛盾，只能當作量級參考。時間方面：一五〇七年戰事主要在夏秋展開；一五〇八年舒伊斯基圍維捷布斯克約在春末至夏初，圍奧爾沙自六月起延續到九月仍未得手，最後的永久和約訂於一五〇八年十月八日。距離方面，莫斯科本土至維捷布斯克、奧爾沙一線約七百至八百公里，糧秣全靠陸運，冰封期更形困難。傷亡與俘獲的精確數字各方記載互有出入，本文不作定論。
dataEn: Only a limited number of figures can be checked, so only the more reliable ones are set down here. As to the weapon: Mons Meg weighs about 4.5 tonnes, its bore is roughly 1,010 millimetres, the chamber holds some 200 kilograms of black powder, the stone ball weighs about 500 kilograms, the stated range is a few hundred metres, the daily powder consumption of a siege of that kind was considerable, and the gun carriages had to be drawn by dozens of oxen and horses. As to the armies: the chronicles call Ivan III's host 'hundred thousand' or 'tens of thousands', but the Muscovite force actually assembled was in the order of tens of thousands, and the Lithuanian, Polish and Tatar coalition was of the same order of magnitude; the exact numbers in the sources contradict one another and can only serve as a rough scale. As to time: the fighting of 1507 was fought out mainly in summer and autumn; in 1508 the siege of Vitebsk ran from late spring into early summer, and the siege of Orsha dragged on from June until September without success, and the permanent peace was finally concluded on 8 October 1508. As to distance: the Muscovite homeland lay some seven to eight hundred kilometres from the line of Vitebsk and Orsha, all supplies came overland, and the frozen season made the task harder still. The precise casualty and prisoner figures differ from source to source and are therefore not asserted here.
cause: 一五〇七年開戰不是偶然。直接導火線是伊凡三世對利沃尼亞的算計：一五〇六至〇七年利沃尼亞騎士團因團長與多爾帕特主教爭鬥而分裂，莫斯科乘虛介入，企圖在立陶宛西面撕開缺口，同時解決對方長期不讓步的兩個爭端——一是「過境」權，即莫斯科大公把邊境居民遷入大公國的權利；二是魯塞尼亞諸城與土地的歸屬，莫斯科主張這些城鎮原是金帳汗國時期莫斯科的領土。深層原因是亞歷山大·雅格隆本人在立陶宛的權威不穩，羅斯系親族與受莫斯科影響的貴族要求限制大公權力，甚至有人與莫斯科往來；克里米亞汗國也因與莫斯科的宿怨願意出兵支持立陶宛。於是伊凡三世把邊界爭執、內部派系與國際時機疊加起來，選在一五〇七年冬去春來之後集中用兵。此戰亦牽動波蘭王室的介入，說明此時立陶宛與波蘭的共體已經能作為一個整體應對莫斯科的壓力。
causeEn: The war of 1507 did not break out by accident. The immediate spark was Ivan III's calculation about Livonia: between 1506 and 1507 the Livonian Order was split by the quarrel between its master and the bishop of Dorpat, and Moscow moved in to take advantage of it, hoping to tear open the western flank of the Grand Duchy while settling at the same time the two questions on which the latter had never given way. The first was the right of peremyshl, the right of the grand prince of Moscow to move inhabitants of the border districts across the frontier into his own state; the second was the ownership of the Ruthenian towns and lands, which Moscow claimed as territories that had belonged to Moscow itself under the Golden Horde. The deeper reason lay in the insecure position of Alexander Jagiellon himself: the Ruthenian kindreds and the magnate families who looked towards Moscow wanted to limit the authority of the grand duke, and some of them were in correspondence with him; the Crimean Horde, hostile to Moscow for its own reasons, was willing to send troops in support of Lithuania. Ivan III thus piled the frontier disputes, the internal factions and the international moment on top of one another and concentrated his force once the winter of 1507 was over. The war also drew the Polish Crown in, which showed that the Lithuanian-Polish community was by then able to answer the pressure from Moscow as a single body.
impact: 一五〇八年的永久和約把前線凍結在第聶伯河與維捷布斯克一帶約十年，莫斯科沒有拿到斯摩稜斯克、波洛茨克與維捷布斯克，魯塞尼亞土地仍屬大公國。這段停火反而讓兩邊都喘過氣：莫斯科把注意力轉向利沃尼亞，十年後再以更兇猛的火力重回立陶宛方向；立陶宛則得以把主要精力放在南方與克里米亞事務上。戰爭的另一個後果在技術層面：一五〇七與〇八年兩度圍城失敗，證明當時俄羅斯的鑄鐵重砲面對加固石造堡壘仍力有不逮，莫斯科之後加速引進外來鑄砲技術並整頓火器衙門，攻城手段也從單純轟擊轉向坑道、爆破與壕壘體系的組合，這條技術路線最終在十六世紀初期的立陶宛戰線上開花。人事上，格林斯基事件成為莫斯科宮廷猜疑的源頭之一，叛逃與通敵從此成為雙方都要防範的常態，軍隊與監察體制的緊張度明顯上升。更長遠看，這場未分勝負的戰爭只是下一次決戰的序曲：數年後的奧爾沙之戰（一五一四年）便讓立陶宛重奪主動，改變了東歐兩大國的均勢。
impactEn: The permanent peace of 1508 froze the front along the Dnieper and the Vitebsk district for about ten years; Moscow obtained neither Smolensk, nor Polotsk, nor Vitebsk, and the Ruthenian lands remained in the hands of the Grand Duchy. The truce gave both sides room to breathe: Moscow turned its attention to Livonia and came back towards the Lithuanian direction ten years later with far more destructive firepower, while Lithuania could give most of its energy to its southern and Crimean affairs. The second consequence was technical. The failure of the sieges of 1507 and 1508 showed that the Muscovite cast-iron heavy guns were still unequal to well-built stone fortresses; Moscow afterwards accelerated the importation of foreign foundry work and the reform of the firearms office, and siegecraft moved away from simple bombardment towards a combination of saps, mines and a full system of trenches, a technical line that was to bear fruit on the Lithuanian front in the early sixteenth century. In personal terms the Glinsky affair became one of the sources of suspicion in the Muscovy court; flight across the border and treason among the nobility became things that both states had to guard against, and the tension in the military and in the surveillance system rose accordingly. In the longer run this inconclusive war was only the prelude to the next one: the great Lithuanian victory at Orsha in 1514 shifted the balance between the two eastern powers.
result: 打到一五〇八年，兩個政府都已經耗盡：莫斯科兩次圍城都沒有攻下維捷布斯克與奧爾沙，立陶宛本土在夏秋之間反覆遭騎兵掠奪，邊區城堡年年被圍，韃靼援軍與波蘭盟友的負擔也到了極限。結果是實質上的平手：十月八日訂立的永久和約大致維持戰前的實際控制線，莫斯科承認大公國對魯塞尼亞城市的主權，換取十年互不侵犯；沒有割地、沒有賠款的條約，讓雙方都保留了日後再戰的權利。戰術層面的勝負更偏向立陶宛：莫斯科在會戰與攻城中都沒有取得戰果，被迫在冬季與疫病中退軍，又失去了格林斯基這樣的內應，士氣與補給都受損；立陶宛雖未收復失地，卻守住了核心堡壘，並且靠拖延與消耗把對手拖到談判桌前。真正的變化發生在戰後：莫斯科把矛頭轉向利沃尼亞，立陶宛得以鞏固南方邊界，兩國的下一輪決鬥被推遲到一五一二至一五年，那一輪最終以奧爾沙的大捷與一五六九年的聯邦改組收場。
resultEn: By 1508 both governments were exhausted. Moscow had failed to take Vitebsk and Orsha in two sieges; the Lithuanian homeland was raided by cavalry again and again in summer and autumn, the border castles were besieged year after year, and the burden on the Tatar auxiliaries and the Polish allies had reached its limit. The result was an effective draw: the permanent peace of 8 October 1508 broadly confirmed the de facto line of control that had existed before the war, Moscow recognised the Grand Duke's sovereignty over the Ruthenian towns in exchange for ten years of non-aggression; with no territory and no indemnity ceded, both sides kept the right to go to war again later. Tactically the balance tilted towards Lithuania: Moscow won nothing in the field or before the walls, was forced to withdraw in the winter and amid disease, and lost the hope of a defector in Glinsky, with morale and supply both suffering; Lithuania, having recovered no lost territory, held its core fortresses and, by delay and attrition, dragged the enemy to the negotiating table. The real change came after the war: Moscow turned its spear against Livonia, Lithuania consolidated its southern frontier, and the next round between the two states was postponed to 1512–1515, a round that ended with the great victory at Orsha and, decades later, with the reform of 1569.
